name: Tatheer Hussain Mir
title: Ph.D. (Doctoral Researcher)
affiliation: Intelligent System Lab (ISLab), National Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology
bio:
An early-career researcher at the Intelligent System Lab (ISLab). I find myself working at the intersection of intelligence and uncertainty where machines attempt to read not only data, but the human condition encoded within it.

I engage with questions of interpretation, temporality, and truth-seeking systems that do not just predict, but justify; that do not merely process, but reveal. Thus, my work is not only about capability, but about responsibility for shaping intelligence that is accountable to the very lives it seeks to assist.

blogs.title: When AI Knows Too Much: Safeguarding Sensitive Health Data - (Tatheer Hussain Mir, Jitendra Jonagaddalla, Hong Jie Dai)
blogs.summary:
The rise of Large Language Models has increased concerns about privacy and data leaks. Health systems use EHRs for research, but these records hold sensitive details that can reveal patient identities. To safely use EHRs and support digital health research, private data must be safeguarded.


Published in Bioengineering & Biotechnology, Research Data, and Computational Sciences
